name: Voxel Generation via 2D Slice Texture
definition: A technique to generate billions of voxels without 3D textures or compression by using a single 2D texture treated as a column of slices. Voxels are generated, rendered to a bitmap (chunk/page), and discarded to save memory.
summary: Voxel Generation via 2D Slice Texture explicitly generates billions of voxels using a single 2D texture column, avoiding 3D textures and minimizing VRAM by discarding data after rendering.
